description: This file contains data classes, database interaction functions, and high-level CRUD operations for managing notes and tags within a note-taking application. It interacts with a database via SQLAlchemy's asynchronous API and defines functions for creating, updating, deleting, listing, and attaching tags to notes.

classes.name: NoteRow
classes.description: Immutable data class representing a row in the notes table, encapsulating note details.

classes.name: TagRow
classes.description: Immutable data class representing a row in the tags table, encapsulating tag details.
